status: preflight only; no CLI colour adapter implemented
findings: Predecessor CLI implements P5/P6/P7, not native PNG. Preserve this product direction; avoid adding a new PNG codec merely for migration.

Official PPM/PGM semantics use BT.709 transfer. sRGB PPM is a common variant requiring explicit identification. PAM RGB/GRAYSCALE inherit those sample meanings; *_ALPHA is straight foreground colour with linear opacity.
Predecessor silently labels RGB input sRGB and ignores most tuple-type distinctions. Do not copy these assumptions into default strict-preservation CLI.

Core TransferFunction already reads/writes bt709; public Modular profile currently permits srgb only. Supporting BT.709 metadata through public API is a sensible prerequisite for standard PNM/PAM, alongside an explicitly selected sRGB variant if needed.

Preserve 8–16 meaningful bits only when MAXVAL equals (1<<bits)-1; other maxvals need explicit representation rather than silent scaling. Reject excess samples/unsupported tuples, concatenated frames and premultiplied export.

Bound header length/tokens/counts and checked raster arithmetic; preserve first raster whitespace/hash byte after exact delimiter, including malicious/truncated cases. Source and output I/O remain subject to current atomic publication/resources.

Need pin source specs in work before implementation, establish predecessor defects with minimal fixtures, add independent semantic oracle and parser/CLI tests, help/manual/capability/provenance updates. Existing NRRD semantics remain separate.
